description: This file defines the AttendanceScreen widget for a Flutter app, which displays attendance records, provides a refresh action, and allows marking attendance via a popup menu.

classes.name: AttendanceScreen
classes.description: A widget that displays attendance records, refreshes data, and allows marking attendance with a popup menu.
